title: EvidenceRecord
description: A fact produced by an executed check or a completed agent review. Never hand-authored for a command that did not run or a review that did not occur. Consumer: ops.mjs evidence run/review (lib/record-store.mjs), stored one-file-per-record under .claude/ops/evidence/<id>.json.

head.description: git commit SHA at recording time (workspaceFingerprint's head component) -- lets gate-engine.mjs's criteria-fresh-evidence check scoped freshness (lib/hash.mjs pathsChangedSince) against a criterion's relevantPaths instead of only whole-workspace fingerprint equality. Absent/null on evidence recorded before this field existed or when git was unavailable.
